# GuardBotApprovalRequired

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.errors.GuardBotApprovalRequired`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(
    bot_id: int,
    query_id: int,
    bot = None
): ...
```

## Documentation

Raised by [`join_chat`](../../../methods/chats/join_chat.md) when a guard bot of the chat must approve the join first.

The approval happens in a Web App of the bot: get its URL with
[`get_guard_bot_web_app_url`](../../../methods/chats/get_guard_bot_web_app_url.md) (passing `query_id`) and wait for the
[`ChatJoinResult`](../../../types/user_and_chats/ChatJoinResult.md) with the same `query_id` (see [`on_chat_join_result`](../../../decorators/on_chat_join_result.md)).

### Parameters

- **`bot_id`** (`int`)
  Identifier of the guard bot.

- **`query_id`** (`int`)
  Identifier of the join request.

- **`bot`** ([`User`](../../../types/user_and_chats/User.md), *optional*)
  The guard bot, if Telegram sent its details.
